data.name: Flutter Template Clean Architecture
content: Products Viewer is a {{Flutter-based products catalog application}} built using the {{DummyJSON Products API}} to demonstrate real-world data consumption and UI rendering.

The app is architected using {{Clean Architecture principles}} and {{Flutter BLoC state management}}, ensuring {{clear separation of concerns}}, {{scalable code structure}}, and a {{maintainable, testable development approach}}.

data.name: Companion App
content: Companion is a {{Flutter-powered AI assistant app}} built with the {{Gemini API}} and submitted to the {{Google Gemini Competition 2024}}, designed to help users understand the world around them in real time.

The app enables users to {{read foreign signs}}, {{extract and understand small texts}}, and {{ask contextual questions}} using AI, while integrating {{speech-to-text}} and {{text-to-speech}} for a {{hands-free, accessible user experience}}.

data.name: Ralph GPT
content: RalphGPT is a {{Discord-based AI assistant bot}} powered by the {{GPT-3 text-davinci-003 model}}, built to bring intelligent and conversational AI directly into community servers.

The bot enables users to {{ask questions}}, {{generate high-quality text responses}}, and {{assist with everyday tasks}} inside Discord, offering a {{seamless AI-powered chat experience}} through simple and natural interactions.

data.name: Wordle Flutter Clone
content: Wordle Clone is a {{Flutter-based word puzzle game}} inspired by the classic Wordle experience, built to deliver a {{simple, fast, and engaging gameplay}} on mobile.

The app challenges players to {{guess the hidden word}}, provides {{real-time visual feedback}}, and demonstrates {{clean UI design}}, {{game logic implementation}}, and {{state management in Flutter}}.

data.name: Domain Information Checker
content: Domain Information Checker is a {{web-based domain lookup tool}} built with {{Next.js}} and {{TypeScript}}, designed to provide quick and reliable insights into domain details.
The app integrates the {{WhoIsAPI}} to {{retrieve domain registration data}}, {{ownership information}}, and {{expiration details}}, offering a {{clean, fast, and user-friendly experience}}.
